setting: free hard spin-2 radiative graviton data at future null infinity; no interactions, no dynamics

T1.name: Sector Connectivity Theorem
T1.statement: W*(A0 u S)' = l^inf(comp G(S)); W*(A0 u S) = (+)_C B(H_C); complete iff G(S) connected
T1.contribution: exactness and unification: subsumes Propositions 1 and 2 and the infrared layer under one criterion

T1.1.name: Spanning-tree resource bound
T1.1.statement: any completing family needs >= N nonzero off-diagonal blocks; the Stokes connector supplies exactly N
T1.1.contribution: upgrades minimality from a type statement to a resource statement

T2.name: Exact Fock commutant
T2.contribution: shows the Fock layer is not Stone-von Neumann irreducibility

T3.name: Linear-connector completion
T3.statement: W*(A_F, Phi(f)) = B(F) for every nonzero f in H_1, via injectivity of a-dagger(f)
T3.contribution: no genericity hypothesis; identifies the soft charge as the missing connector type; locates the failure at f not in H_1

T4.name: Memory dichotomy
T4.statement: if memory sectors are disjoint the graph is empty and no connector exists inside the algebra; if not, edges exist and Theorem 1 classifies the result
T4.contribution: both branches closed; no bet placed on an unsettled premise

T5.name: Localization of the residue
T5.statement: the commutant is abelian; the representation is multiplicity-free; the sector label is measurable
T5.contribution: all residual invisibility is classical superselection, never quantum degeneracy

T6.name: Spectral-gap form of completeness
T6.statement: ||c - cbar|| <= ||[X,S]||_HS / sqrt(2 lambda_2(L)), sharp on the Fiedler eigenvector
T6.contribution: replaces an exact-zero criterion by a sharp metric one; lambda_2 is the modulus

T7.name: Dimension-free operator-norm bound
T7.statement: dist(X, C I) <= (1/2) D_R ||[X,S]||_op with D_R the resistance diameter
T7.contribution: valid in the continuum where Hilbert-Schmidt norms diverge

T8.name: Exact su(2) spectral gap
T8.statement: spec(L) = lambda^2 k(k+1), k=0..N; lambda_2 = 2 lambda^2 exactly, independent of N; extremal operator is N_R
T8.contribution: the modulus of asymptotic graviton tomography does not degrade with graviton number

T9.name: Infrared rate reconciliation
T9.statement: lambda_2(mu) > 0 for every finite regulator; lambda_2(mu) -> 0 as mu -> 0
T9.contribution: the two opposing positions on memory superselection differ by an order of limits, not by a fact
